topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Ran into an old lady today, selling off her life on the front lawn. Bunch of junk, most of it. But there, tucked in the corner, was a sight I hadn't expected. A raggedy teddy bear, eyes a bit clouded, fur worn thin. Recognized it right away. Hadn’t seen it in decades, but it was mine, my only friend for a long while. Asked her how much, paid her without haggling. She looked surprised but took the bills, hands trembling. Held that bear tight and walked away, leaving the past behind. Some things, you just don’t let go. Not when they mean something. Not when they bring you back to where you started, remind you of who you were.
